claims: St. John's Red Storm played Kansas Jayhawks in the second round of the 2026 NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament.
The game took place on Sunday, March 22, 2026.
St. John's Red Storm won the game 67–65.
St. John's Red Storm was the No. 5 seed.
Kansas Jayhawks was the No. 4 seed.
St. John's Red Storm advanced to the Sweet 16 to face either Duke or TCU.
CBS provided the national broadcast of the game.
The game was available to stream live via Paramount+, Fubo, and SlingTV.
Radio coverage of the game was available on SiriusXM Channel 203.
The tip-off time was 5:15 p.m. ET (4:15 p.m. CT).
The venue was Viejas Arena in San Diego, California.
The broadcast crew consisted of Kevin Harlan (play-by-play), Robbie Hummel and Stan Van Gundy (analysts), and Lauren Shehadi (reporter).
